report.explanation: Alert claims checkout error-rate and latency issues, but all current gateway evidence is healthy: one OK checkout span (63ms), error_rate 0.001, p95 79ms, zero dependency timeouts and db pool waiters, INFO 200 logs. No downstream telemetry is available. Current facts contradict the alert and cannot substantiate any bounded root-cause candidate, so hand off for broader evidence.
missing_evidence: Current gateway error-rate/latency telemetry showing the alert condition (observed metrics show error_rate 0.001, p95 79ms, healthy)
Downstream service telemetry for order, payment, inventory, postgresql, redis to locate the fault
Logs/traces with error or timeout detail beyond a single OK checkout span
